requirement.text: The data tied to a person can be found and is eraseable in the system upon request.

initial_eus.title: Locatable and Erasable Personal Data
initial_eus.description: As a data subject, I want the data tied to me to be locatable and erasable in the system upon request, so that my personal data can be removed when I ask for it.
work_items: Data tied to a person can be found in the system.
Data tied to a person can be erased from the system upon request.

analysis.ethical_objective: Enable individuals to exercise control over their personal data by ensuring that data tied to a person can be located and erased upon request.

obligations.text: Data tied to a person must be locatable within the system.
obligations.source_span: The data tied to a person can be found

obligations.text: Data tied to a person must be erasable from the system upon request.
obligations.source_span: is eraseable in the system upon request

constraints: Erasure applies to data tied to a person.
ambiguities: The source does not specify who may make the erasure request (e.g., the data subject or another party).
The source does not specify whether finding data is itself request-triggered or a general system capability.
The source does not define what counts as 'data tied to a person' or the completeness of erasure (e.g., copies, backups, derived data).
The source does not specify any timeframe, procedure, confirmation, or exceptions for erasure.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume a specific legal framework (e.g., GDPR right to erasure) or its conditions.
Do not assume a timeframe or deadline for erasure.
Do not assume a particular identity verification or request-handling process.
Do not assume that erasure must extend to backups, third parties, or derived data unless specified.
Do not assume that the requester must be the data subject.
Do not assume confirmation or notification obligations after erasure.
possible_operational_aspects: Ability to find data tied to a person in the system.
Erasure of data tied to a person performed in response to a request.

work_items.explanation: The work item states that data tied to a person can be found in the system, directly expressing the obligation that such data be locatable (O1).
The work item states that data tied to a person can be erased from the system upon request, directly expressing the obligation of request-triggered erasure (O2).
